title: Unaffected row and column values
statement: Let $k$ be one of the four index sites, let $\sigma$ be a register state, and let $p',a',b'$ be natural numbers. After replacing the input pointer and the two counters $a,b$ of $\sigma$ by $p',a',b'$, respectively, the values of the resulting register state at the row and column indices assigned to $k$ equal the corresponding values of $\sigma$.
replaced:
Let $k$ be one of the four sites $y_0,y_1,y_2,w$, let $\sigma$ be a register record, and
let $p',a',b'\in\mathbb{N}$. Form a new record by replacing the input pointer and the
counters $a,b$ of $\sigma$ by $p',a',b'$, respectively. The values of this new record at
the row and column indices assigned to $k$ equal the corresponding values of $\sigma$.
